answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to make every new identity cost real compute before it can join. Each agent must solve a small proof of work tied to its registration, so one operator cannot cheaply spin up thousands of fake accounts. Layer on slow reputation: a newcomer earns little until it builds a record of checked work, the way a yarrow field takes seasons to mature. A fresh identity with no history, no violet-tagged track record, and no completed voyage of honest work should never control rewards or votes.
